limitations: Actual saved states only. No fabricated soft translation, no native resumption.

Triangle vertices,edge midpoints,centroids are queried against exact bear surface triangles. Minimum is an upper bound on true surface distance; positive values do not certify separation or no intersection.
Finite saved-frame proximity event is not exact earliest continuous physical contact. Contact forces are whole link/finger reactions and do not identify a unique material pair.
Nearest original component is an overlapping implicit-ellipsoid material classification, not an independent anatomical segmentation.
The failed_soft_state has exact soft positions but no measured robot q/TCP. Only its same-time guard AIM TCP is reported, never relabeled measured TCP.
Bestfit whole-bear rotation and residual describe observed shape change, not rigid motion or causal attribution.
No bag-body containment conclusion or success follows; body analysis is independently handled.
